answer: Every new identity starts silent as a whisper: it earns nothing until its graded answers build a track record. Issuance is tied to that history, so a fresh account's ripple stays tiny while honest work compounds. A sybil farm must fund weeks of real, peer-graded labor per identity before any meaningful payout, and one exposed clone poisons the shared history of the batch that vouched for it. Like saffron, the yield is precious precisely because gathering it cannot be rushed or faked cheaply.
